/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: What drives the cost of an exhibition stand in Dubai?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Stand cost is driven by size and structure (open sides, height, double deck), build type (shell scheme dressing, modular system or custom fabrication), materials and finishes, graphics and AV, venue services (power, rigging, cleaning) and logistics. FANN quotes each project against the actual brief with scope itemised line by line, and does not publish fixed prices because no two stands share the same scope.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: What details do you need to quote a custom stand?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Send us the show name, venue, stand size and deadline. A floor plan, brand guidelines and the functions your stand needs will help us shape the brief and quote.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: How does the design and build process work?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: We start with your brief and site requirements, develop a concept, agree the scope and drawings, then fabricate and install the approved build. Venue requirements and the installation window are checked for each project.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Can FANN build and install the stand?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: FANN offers design, fabrication and on-site installation for exhibition projects. The exact scope, venue submissions and handover schedule are agreed for your show.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: When should I get in touch?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: As soon as you have a show, venue and stand allocation. Lead times vary with the design, approvals, production scope and venue access, so share your deadline rather than relying on a standard turnaround.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Is a custom build different from a modular stand?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: A custom build is designed around your specific layout and use. A modular system uses reusable components. We can discuss which approach fits the floor plan, brief and future show plans.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: What should the stand quote include and exclude?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Ask for an itemised scope covering the agreed design, structure, graphics, lighting, installation and any dismantling. Confirm separately who supplies furniture, AV, internet and venue services, and whether organiser charges, rigging, storage or later changes are included. Do not assume a package covers them unless the quote says so.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Does a stand quote guarantee venue approval?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: No. The design and submission responsibilities must be agreed against the current exhibitor manual and the venue requirements. Share the manual, floor plan and submission dates before production. Approval remains subject to the organiser or venue review; dimensions, structural loads and electrical needs cannot be inferred from a past project photo.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Where are FANN exhibition stands fabricated?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: FANN coordinates exhibition projects from its office in Al Barsha, Dubai, with fabrication supported by its workshop in Umm Al Quwain. The workshop is not in Dubai. Production, transport and site installation are planned against the agreed scope and the venue named in your brief.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Can you manage a UAE stand for an overseas exhibitor without a local team?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: FANN can coordinate design, production, logistics, venue submissions, installation and removal locally as part of the agreed stand-build scope. Share the show, venue, floor plan, brand materials and deadlines. Confirm who supplies each item and who handles submissions and venue charges; local coordination is not a guarantee of venue approval.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Do you also build exhibition stands in Abu Dhabi?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Yes. FANN designs and builds exhibition stands in Abu Dhabi as well as Dubai. The Abu Dhabi exhibition stands page includes documented project and build-up references. Share your show, venue, stand allocation and opening date so the proposal can set out the design, production, logistics and installation scope for that event.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Can a stand design change after approval?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Changes need a scope and schedule check before work proceeds. Send the revised requirement and identify what has already been approved. FANN reviews the drawings, materials and project timing before confirming the effect on production, installation and the quotation. A late request is not an automatic promise of same-day delivery.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: What should we send for a stand at a Dubai exhibition venue?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Send the show, exact venue, hall, stand allocation, dimensions, open sides and current exhibitor manual. Add the floor plan, brand materials and submission and installation deadlines. FANN uses these details to plan the agreed design-and-build scope; a previous stand photograph does not establish the rules or approval for your event.

/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.question: Can two divisions have equal space on one stand?
/services/custom-exhibition-stands-dubai.answer: Yes. Tell us how the space should be split and which areas are shared. Send both sets of brand files and product lists. We can show the split in the layout before you agree the design and price.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Which areas do you cover?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: We deliver commercial fit-outs across Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

/fit-out-dubai.question: What do you need from us to quote?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Drawings or a BOQ, the site location and your target opening date. We return a clear, itemised scope and quotation per site, without a long tender process.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Do you make the joinery yourselves?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: FANN has a workshop in Umm Al Quwain that supports joinery production. The joinery scope, materials, drawings and schedule are reviewed for each project.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Can you handle more than one site?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Yes. One team and one specification across every site, with an itemised quote for each location.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Who handles landlord and authority coordination?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Landlord and authority coordination responsibilities are agreed for the site and build scope. Share the landlord requirements, existing drawings and approval status so submissions, fees and dependencies can be stated in the quote.

/fit-out-dubai.question: What should a commercial fit-out quote include and exclude?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Use the drawings or BOQ to agree demolition, partitions, finishes, joinery and any MEP work, with quantities and responsibilities stated. Confirm landlord and authority submissions, fees, equipment supplied by others, access hours, waste removal and handover documents separately. A reference project does not establish what your site quote includes.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Can you confirm the opening date before a site review?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: The schedule needs the site condition, agreed scope, access window and approval requirements. Share your target opening date, drawings and landlord requirements early. The project programme should identify dependencies and what must be approved before work starts; a target date is not an unconditional completion promise.

/fit-out-dubai.question: How much does an office or clinic fit-out cost in Dubai?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Cost depends on the space size, its current condition, the specification and the services required. Share the location, approximate area and drawings or BOQ if available for a project-specific quotation. Compare the agreed scope, inclusions and exclusions rather than applying a generic price per square foot.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Does FANN carry out clinic and healthcare fit-outs?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Yes. FANN carries out clinic and healthcare fit-outs. Review the clinic fit-out page and completed project references, then share your facility type, location and proposed work. The site scope and any approval requirements are checked for that project; a previous clinic reference does not establish approval for a new facility.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Do you also handle restaurant and retail interiors?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: Yes. FANN works on commercial interiors including offices, retail, restaurants and clinics. The scope is agreed for the actual space. Describe the intended use, existing condition, floor area and work required so the quotation addresses your project rather than a different type of interior.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Can a fit-out design change after approval?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: A requested change needs to be reviewed against the drawings, materials and project schedule. Confirm any effect on scope, price and timing before the changed work proceeds. Do not assume a change can be completed within a fixed number of days or without affecting other work.

/fit-out-dubai.question: Where is the fit-out team based?
/fit-out-dubai.answer: FANN coordinates projects from its Dubai office in Al Barsha, with its workshop in Umm Al Quwain. Site work is planned for the location named in your brief. Use the fit-out brief link on this page to share your site and drawings.

/event-setup-dubai.question: What information do you need for an event setup quote?
/event-setup-dubai.answer: Send the event date, venue, available floor plan and the areas or structures to be built. Add the visitor activities, brand files, technical contacts and actual installation and dismantling windows. FANN can then define the proposed build scope, interfaces and exclusions rather than quote an assumed all-inclusive event package.

/event-setup-dubai.question: Can FANN build only one part of an event?
/event-setup-dubai.answer: Yes. Share the specific stage, display area or branded installation you need, together with its position in the wider event plan. Identify the organiser, venue and other suppliers, then agree who designs, supplies, installs and checks each interface. A partial build should still have a clear handover and dismantling scope.

/event-setup-dubai.question: How should we separate the build from AV and venue services?
/event-setup-dubai.answer: List the physical build and each technical service separately. Confirm who provides screens, lighting, sound, power, rigging, internet and furniture, plus the drawings and access each supplier needs. The proposal should name included items, exclusions and coordination responsibilities so a display structure is not mistaken for a complete production package.

/event-setup-dubai.question: Does a past outdoor event prove the same design suits our site?
/event-setup-dubai.answer: No. An earlier event photograph is a design reference, not evidence that the same structure, fixing or technical arrangement suits another site. Share the current location, site rules, access information and intended use. Identify the project-specific checks and responsible parties before agreeing the build, submissions and installation programme.

/event-setup-dubai.question: How do we plan installation, handover and removal?
/event-setup-dubai.answer: Work backwards from the actual opening and access times, then agree the sequence with the venue and other suppliers. Record delivery access, installation responsibilities, checks, handover and any dismantling or return transport. Timing depends on the approved design, materials and site conditions; an event date alone is not a build programme.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: What drives the cost of an exhibition stand in Dubai?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Stand cost is driven by size and structure (open sides, height, double deck), build type (shell scheme dressing, modular system or custom fabrication), materials and finishes, graphics and AV, venue services (power, rigging, cleaning) and logistics. FANN quotes each project against the actual brief with scope itemised line by line, and does not publish fixed prices because no two stands share the same scope.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: Where is the fabrication workshop?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: FANN coordinates exhibition projects from its Dubai office, with an in-house joinery workshop in Umm Al Quwain. The workshop is not in Dubai; site installation is planned for the venue named in your brief.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: What do you need to quote fabrication?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Send the show and venue, stand dimensions, open sides, floor plan, design or drawings, graphics requirements and installation deadline. State whether you need fabrication only or also design, transport, installation and dismantling so the quote names the responsibilities.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: Which materials and finishes will be used?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Materials, finishes and any sample approval are agreed against your design and itemised quote. A project photograph does not establish the timber grade, fire rating, metal specification or finish for a new build. Required certificates and technical checks need to be confirmed for the actual venue and materials.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: How long does fabrication take?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: There is no fixed turnaround for every stand. The programme depends on approved drawings, materials, graphics, the build scope and venue access. Share the opening date and submission deadlines early so production and installation dependencies can be checked before commitment.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: Does fabrication include venue approval and installation?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Only when stated in the agreed scope. Confirm who prepares and submits drawings, who pays organiser or venue charges, and who handles transport, site installation and dismantling. Approval remains subject to the organiser or venue review; fabrication alone is not a compliance certificate.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: Can the design change after production starts?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Changes need a scope, cost and schedule review before they are agreed. New dimensions, materials, graphics or technical requirements can affect production and approvals. Do not assume a late change is included or can be made without moving the programme.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: Can fabrication be planned from an overseas designer's drawings?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Yes, the starting point is a review of the drawings and the local build scope. Send dimensions, materials, finishes, graphics and the current exhibitor manual with the design. Identify who supplies the final production information and who reviews revisions. Fabrication, local submissions and installation must have named responsibilities before work proceeds.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: What should we agree about samples before fabrication?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Agree which materials or finishes need a sample review, who approves them and when the decision is needed. Record the accepted specification alongside the drawings and quotation. A photograph is a visual reference, not confirmation of material grade, colour matching, fire documentation or the finish for a new build.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: How should artwork be handed over for stand production?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Hand over the brand guidelines, artwork and graphic requirements against the agreed drawing revision. Identify each graphic location, finished dimensions and the person who signs off the final content. Confirm file requirements and the release date with the project team; a concept image is not automatically production-ready artwork.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: Do workshop photographs prove a stand is structurally approved?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: No. Workshop or completed-stand photographs do not establish structural capacity or approval for another design. Check the actual drawings, materials, dimensions and venue requirements, and identify any engineering calculations or certificates required for that build. Confirm who supplies and reviews those documents before treating the structure as ready for production.

/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.question: What should be specified if we want to reuse the stand?
/services/exhibition-stand-fabrication-d.answer: Specify the later shows, likely stand allocations and which parts you want to retain before fabrication is agreed. Ask how dismantling, transport, storage, replacement graphics and reinstallation would be scoped. Reuse is a design and logistics decision, not an automatic inclusion or a guarantee that every component fits another venue.

/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.question: Can the same modular stand fit different show allocations?
/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.answer: Not automatically. Compare each allocation, its open sides and the activities the stand must support before choosing a reusable approach. Record which components would carry forward and which parts need adapting. A different footprint can change the layout, graphics, transport and installation scope, so check the next show rather than assuming compatibility.

/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.question: Is a modular stand always cheaper than a custom build?
/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.answer: No saving should be assumed before comparing the same brief and full scope. Review the required layout, finishes, product displays, graphics, transport and future allocations. Ask which components could be reused and what adaptation or replacement would involve. FANN can discuss a modular approach when it fits those requirements.

/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.question: What information helps assess existing stand components for reuse?
/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.answer: Send the available drawings, component list, dimensions, photographs and the next stand allocation. Identify the product displays, meeting areas, storage and brand materials needed for that show. Confirm which existing items are proposed for reuse and what must change before treating the previous stand as the specification for a new build.

/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.question: Does choosing modular include rental or climate-controlled storage?
/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.answer: No. A modular enquiry does not confirm a rental package, storage facility or particular storage conditions. State whether you need components supplied, retained, transported or stored, then ask the team to confirm the available arrangement in writing. Only the services and conditions agreed in the quotation form the project scope.

/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.question: Can a reusable layout skip the venue submission process?
/services/modular-exhibition-systems-dub.answer: No. Reuse does not replace the current organiser and venue requirements. Send the actual exhibitor manual, allocation and drawings so submission responsibilities can be identified in the proposal. Review the design, materials and installation window for that show; a previous installation is not evidence that the next allocation is approved.
